_note: Genetic Synapse trees (Host). Per class, three paths of five nodes, unlocked in order along each path. Cost is DNA plus Raw Mutagen Vials (× the class mutagenCostMultiplier); level is the class level required. effect is applied by the ability/stat system; visual is the brief for Creature & Mutation: every node changes the silhouette or glow pattern (Art Bible rule 2). Mutation stages grow in order nodes → growths → new limbs/carapace (rule 3). colour names a key of PATH in src/render/palette.ts (never a hex here).
